trigger: The official Afrobarometer download endpoint returned an anti-bot HTML challenge rather than the registered SAV bytes in the batch execution environment. HCP RGPH and ENCDM source downloads succeeded.
scientific_decision: Do not fabricate, independently sample, or infer person-level political attitudes merely to satisfy the RICH target. The primary x10 voter-state gate must pass without any person-level Afrobarometer donor variables.

supersedes.asv2_rich_enrichment_contract_v1.data_ga: Survey existence and pre-election timing remain required for contextual validity, but respondent-level attachment is not required in the primary voter-state arm when exact raw bytes are inaccessible. Aggregate survey context may be added only as a territory/common context and is not counted toward the x10 information gate.
supersedes.asv2_rich_feature_manifest_v1.source_fam: Reclassified as AFROBAROMETER_PRE_ELECTION_AGGREGATE_CONTEXT_RESERVED; no person-level donor features in RICH V2.

interpretation: Passing RICH V2 is stronger than the earlier design with respect to the x10 claim because the information-rank threshold must be met by observed anonymized HCP microprofiles, household joint structure, statistically matched ENCDM socioeconomic state, prior-election anchoring and pre-election labour context without synthetic respondent-level attitude noise.
